title: Jean-Louis Naudin's vacuum-tube tests

tellings.quote: He's done it in vacuum tubes.

plain: Gary McKinnon, a computer hacker who says he found signs of a secret space program in NASA's systems, told podcast host Jesse Michels about an experimenter in France named Jean-Louis Naudin. McKinnon says Naudin has repeated his experiments inside vacuum tubes, sealed glass tubes with the air pumped out. He mentions it because a result that holds up in a vacuum would rule out air as the cause.
